save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state to a .pth file
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint including optimizer and scheduler state from a .pth file
load_model_only: load only the model state dict from a checkpoint file without optimizer or scheduler
check_checkpoint_exists: check if a last_checkpoint file exists in the save directory to determine if resuming is possible
get_checkpoint_file: get the path of the most recently saved checkpoint file from the last_checkpoint metadata file
